security_justification.audit_integrity: No audit event, contract, checksum or governance assertion changes; preventing fixture housekeeping races keeps required checks focused on the gates under test.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication, authorization, principal or permission decision changes; the two flags govern only Git housekeeping in synthetic fixture repositories.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No authority source, owner decision or signed evidence changes; pinned-file edits must retain identical five-stage precedence results, and the next owner review re-pins them without any review claim here.
security_justification.concurrency: The correction prevents a detached Git maintenance writer in temporary fixtures but introduces no scheduler, lock, shared state or concurrent coordination mechanism.
security_justification.confidentiality: No secrets, credentials or confidential payload handling changes; command-line settings concern only local disposable fixture Git state.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic algorithm, key, signature or verification behavior changes; fixture identity and signing settings and all signed governance records remain unchanged.
security_justification.error_disclosure: No diagnostic or error reporting surface changes; existing invocation assertions and removal errors remain observable without additional data disclosure.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security product, network service, exporter, collector deployment or third-party integration changes; the correction is local test-fixture configuration.
security_justification.fail_posture: The known housekeeping writer is prevented before it starts; existing fail-closed gate assertions and loud one-shot removal failures are neither weakened nor retried away.
security_justification.lifecycle: No runtime, release or governance lifecycle transition changes; only wrapper Git commands within existing disposable fixture lifetimes gain maintenance settings.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: No persistent configuration is written; exact three-file wrapper ownership bounds the changes, while signed records, pin sets, lifecycle evidence, call sites and other owned files remain untouched.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No personal data, telemetry, redaction, classification or privacy transformation changes; these tests retain their synthetic repository inputs.
security_justification.resource_retention: No retention policy or cleanup ownership changes; existing disposal removes the temporary repository without a detached housekeeping writer racing its use or removal.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No retry, delivery, redelivery, queue or attempt behavior changes; the existing wrappers and removal paths remain unchanged beyond the two command-line settings.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Existing local fixture and live-repository boundaries remain unchanged; command-line precedence suppresses only two inherited settings, adding no principal, external system or trust crossing.
